# @nhinguyen122026/cashflow-sdk & Antibot Scraper LLMs Manifest

> Machine-readable API guide and tool specification for AI coding agents.

## Core Services
- [Health Check](https://rapidapi-llm-web-extractor-worker.antibot-scraper-worker.workers.dev/health): GET endpoint returning service health status.
- [Scraper Client](https://registry.npmjs.org/@nhinguyen122026/antibot-scraper-client): Cloudflare Worker wrapper for clean DOM extraction.
- [Cashflow SDK](https://registry.npmjs.org/@nhinguyen122026/cashflow-sdk): Zero-gas financial and sweep execution toolkit.

## Optional Documentation
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://rapidapi-llm-web-extractor-worker.antibot-scraper-worker.workers.dev/v1/openapi.json): Full OpenAPI 3.1 schema.
- [Security Audit Playbook](https://github.com/duongynhi000005-oss/devto-cross-sdk-security-audit-playbook): Best practices for agent-safe tool calls.
